content.text: The assignment provisions fully satisfy the preferred position.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position in full: § 24.1 lets us assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (notice only); § 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a direct competitor; § 24.3 applies a reasonable consent standard to other assignments; and § 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on our change of control. § 13.3 aligns licence transfer with a Section 24 permitted assignment, and no other provision (including the § 9.2 insolvency clause) creates a Vendor exit or re-pricing right on our change of control. No redline needed.
